entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Though hordes stand against you, they rarely stand long.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Bull Rush, worshiper of the associated deity.

Benefit(s): When you bull rush a creature and your check exceeds the target’s CMD by 5 or more, you deal damage equal to your Strength modifier to that target.
